page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.c1 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.
This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network configurations do not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With dedicated CPU allocation and a low memory-to-core ratio, the instance is structured for compute-bound tasks that do not require large memory footprints or local storage. It is suitable for workloads such as distributed compute nodes, batch processing, and lightweight web serving where dedicated CPU execution is required.
